intro: Jahan Hawkwing is a tauren armorer stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He provides essential leather and chainmail gear to travelers braving the harsh, predator-filled plains.

p: Situated at the bustling hub of the Crossroads, Jahan Hawkwing tends to the equipment needs of Horde wanderers and defenders. The Barrens is a brutal expanse where durable protective gear often makes the difference between survival and falling to centaur, quillboar, or wild beasts. Jahan works alongside local leatherworkers, handling deliveries of cured hides to keep his shop stocked with reliable tanned leather and sturdy chainmail.
